idea: When to replace old plumbing pipes
title: How to Tell When Old Water Pipes Need Replacement
description: Plumbing pipes do not last forever, and waiting for a pipe to burst can lead to severe structural water damage. Galvanized steel supply pipes generally last 40 to 50 years, while copper lines often serve for 50 years or more depending on local water chemistry. Clear indicators that your system requires replacement include persistent drop in water pressure, rusty or discolored water from cold taps, visible mineral crusting around fittings, and frequent pinhole leaks. If your home has original galvanized steel or polybutylene piping, schedule a professional inspection to assess wall thickness and system integrity before an emergency happens.
